dimensions.assessment: Affects youth participants ages 14 to 23 and the Congressional Award Board administrators.
dimensions.evidence: awards medals to youth ages 14 to 23 who satisfy standards of achievement set by the board

dimensions.assessment: Extends an existing youth recognition program and updates medal material specifications.
dimensions.evidence: removes a requirement for program medals to consist of gold-plate over bronze, rhodium over bronze, or bronze

dimensions.assessment: No specific federal appropriations or funding changes are mentioned in the source text.
Modifies sunset dates and technical criteria within the existing Congressional Award Act.
dimensions.evidence: Section 108 of the Congressional Award Act (2 U.S.C. 808) is amended by striking `October 1, 2023` and inserting `October 1, 2028`

dimensions.assessment: Extends program authorization for a fixed five-year period.

missing_information: Exact annual budget or funding levels for the Congressional Award Board
importance_detail.rationale: Reauthorizes the Congressional Award Board through October 1, 2028, and removes specific metal composition requirements for program medals.
